Properties of request methods| Method | RFC | Request has payload body | Response has payload body | Safe | Idempotent | Cacheable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TRACE | [RFC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RFC_(identifier) "RFC (identifier)")[9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |

The methods GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, TRACE, and QUERY are defined as safe. In other words, safe methods are intended to be [read-only](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Command%E2%80%93query_separation "Command–query separation").
In contrast, the methods POST, PUT, DELETE, CONNECT, and PATCH are not safe.
